examples.en: She decided to devote her weekends to helping at the animal shelter.
examples.zh: 她決定把週末的時間投入動物收容所的志工服務。

examples.en: Many teachers devote years to improving their students' reading skills.
examples.zh: 許多老師花好幾年的時間致力於提升學生的閱讀能力。

examples.en: He devotes an hour every evening to practicing the piano.
examples.zh: 他每天晚上都花一個小時練習鋼琴。

examples.en: Prices differ from store to store, so compare them first.
examples.zh: 每家店的價格都不一樣，所以要先比較。

examples.en: My sister and I differ in our taste in music.
examples.zh: 我和姊姊的音樂品味不同。

examples.en: The two managers differ on how to solve the problem.
examples.zh: 這兩位經理對於如何解決問題的看法不同。

examples.en: Drinking warm water can help you digest food more easily.
examples.zh: 喝溫水可以幫助你更容易消化食物。

examples.en: It took me a while to digest the long report.
examples.zh: 我花了一點時間才消化那份很長的報告。

examples.en: Babies cannot digest some foods until they are older.
examples.zh: 嬰兒要等到大一點才能消化某些食物。

examples.en: The magazine publishes a monthly digest of health news.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌每月刊登一份健康新聞摘要。

examples.en: I read a short digest of the book before the exam.
examples.zh: 考試前我讀了這本書的簡短摘要。

examples.en: The weekly digest of school events is posted online.
examples.zh: 每週的校園活動摘要會張貼在網路上。

examples.en: My father bought a new digital camera for our trip.
examples.zh: 我爸爸為了我們的旅行買了一台新的數位相機。

examples.en: The store sells both paper books and digital books.
examples.zh: 這家店同時販售紙本書和電子書。

examples.en: A digital clock on the wall showed the time.
examples.zh: 牆上的數位時鐘顯示著時間。

examples.en: Every person should be treated with dignity and respect.
examples.zh: 每個人都應該受到有尊嚴的尊重對待。

examples.en: She walked out of the room with great dignity.
examples.zh: 她十分莊重地走出了房間。

examples.en: Losing the contest did not hurt his dignity.
examples.zh: 輸掉比賽並沒有傷到他的自尊。

examples.en: Her diligence helped her finish the project early.
examples.zh: 她的勤奮讓她提早完成了專案。

examples.en: The teacher praised the students for their diligence.
examples.zh: 老師稱讚學生們的勤勉。

examples.en: Success often comes from diligence rather than luck.
examples.zh: 成功往往來自勤奮而不是運氣。

examples.en: He received his high school diploma last June.
examples.zh: 他去年六月拿到了高中畢業證書。

examples.en: You need a diploma to apply for this job.
examples.zh: 你需要有文憑才能應徵這份工作。

examples.en: She hung her diploma on the wall of her office.
examples.zh: 她把畢業證書掛在辦公室的牆上。

examples.en: One disadvantage of this phone is its short battery life.
examples.zh: 這支手機的一個缺點是電池續航力很短。

examples.en: Not speaking English can be a big disadvantage when you travel.
examples.zh: 旅行時不會說英文可能是很大的劣勢。

examples.en: The small team had a disadvantage against taller players.
examples.zh: 這支小隊面對比較高的球員時處於劣勢。

examples.en: I don't want to disappoint my parents.
examples.zh: 我不想讓我的父母失望。

examples.en: The long wait for the show may disappoint some fans.
examples.zh: 等待表演的時間太長，可能會讓一些粉絲失望。

examples.en: The movie did not disappoint us at all.
examples.zh: 這部電影一點都沒有讓我們失望。

examples.en: The typhoon was a disaster for the farmers in the area.
examples.zh: 這場颱風對當地的農民來說是一場災難。

examples.en: The school holds a drill to prepare students for a disaster.
examples.zh: 學校舉辦演練，讓學生為災害做好準備。

examples.en: Our first cooking class was a complete disaster.
examples.zh: 我們的第一堂烹飪課簡直是一場慘敗。

examples.en: The coach demands strict discipline from the team.
examples.zh: 教練要求球隊遵守嚴格的紀律。

examples.en: It takes discipline to wake up early every morning.
examples.zh: 每天早起需要自律。

examples.en: Biology is a discipline that studies living things.
examples.zh: 生物學是研究生物的一門學科。

examples.en: Parents should discipline their children with patience.
examples.zh: 父母應該有耐心地管教孩子。

examples.en: The company will discipline workers who break the safety rules.
examples.zh: 公司會懲處違反安全規定的員工。

examples.en: She tries to discipline herself to save money each month.
examples.zh: 她努力訓練自己每個月存錢。

examples.en: Don't let one bad grade discourage you from studying.
examples.zh: 不要讓一次成績不好使你對讀書感到氣餒。

examples.en: High prices discourage many people from buying new cars.
examples.zh: 高昂的價格使許多人不願購買新車。

examples.en: The teacher discouraged students from using their phones in class.
examples.zh: 老師勸阻學生在課堂上使用手機。

examples.en: He wore a wig to disguise himself at the costume party.
examples.zh: 他在變裝派對上戴假髮來偽裝自己。

examples.en: She tried to disguise her disappointment with a smile.
examples.zh: 她試著用微笑掩飾自己的失望。

examples.en: The cook disguised the vegetables in the soup so the kids would eat them.
examples.zh: 廚師把蔬菜藏在湯裡，讓孩子們願意吃。

examples.en: The actor wore a clever disguise in the play.
examples.zh: 這位演員在劇中穿著巧妙的喬裝。

examples.en: A pair of glasses was his only disguise.
examples.zh: 一副眼鏡是他唯一的偽裝。

examples.en: The costume shop sells masks and other disguises.
examples.zh: 這家服裝店販售面具和其他偽裝道具。

examples.en: She looked at the dirty kitchen with disgust.
examples.zh: 她厭惡地看著髒亂的廚房。

examples.en: The smell of the old fish filled me with disgust.
examples.zh: 那股腐壞魚肉的味道讓我覺得噁心。

examples.en: He showed his disgust by leaving the room.
examples.zh: 他離開房間來表達自己的厭惡。

examples.en: The messy bathroom disgusted the guests.
examples.zh: 凌亂的浴室讓客人們感到厭惡。

examples.en: It disgusts me when people throw trash on the street.
examples.zh: 人們在路上亂丟垃圾讓我覺得很噁心。

examples.en: The smell of the rotten eggs disgusted everyone in the class.
examples.zh: 臭掉的蛋的味道讓全班的人都覺得噁心。

examples.en: The teacher dismissed the class at noon.
examples.zh: 老師在中午讓全班下課。

examples.en: The company dismissed him for being late too often.
examples.zh: 公司因為他太常遲到而把他解僱了。

examples.en: Please don't dismiss her idea before you hear it.
examples.zh: 在聽完之前，請不要把她的想法置之不理。

examples.en: Her desk was in complete disorder after the exam week.
examples.zh: 考試週過後，她的書桌一片混亂。

examples.en: Sleep disorder can make it hard to focus at school.
examples.zh: 睡眠失調會讓人很難在學校集中注意力。

examples.en: The doctor explained the causes of the disorder.
examples.zh: 醫生說明了這種疾病的成因。

examples.en: The two neighbors had a dispute over the fence.
examples.zh: 兩位鄰居為了圍籬起了爭執。

examples.en: The labor dispute was finally settled last week.
examples.zh: 這場勞資糾紛終於在上週解決了。

examples.en: There is a dispute about who owns the land.
examples.zh: 關於誰擁有這塊土地還有爭議。

examples.en: My brother and I often dispute who should wash the dishes.
examples.zh: 我哥哥和我常常為了該誰洗碗而爭論。

examples.en: Nobody disputes that exercise is good for your health.
examples.zh: 沒有人否認運動對健康有益。

examples.en: The customer disputed the charge on his bill.
examples.zh: 這位顧客對帳單上的費用提出異議。

examples.en: There is a distinct smell of coffee in the hallway.
examples.zh: 走廊裡有明顯的咖啡香味。

examples.en: Each country has its own distinct culture.
examples.zh: 每個國家都有自己獨特的文化。

examples.en: The two words have distinct meanings in this sentence.
examples.zh: 這兩個字在這個句子裡有不同的意思。

examples.en: It is hard to distinguish the twins from each other.
examples.zh: 很難分辨這對雙胞胎。

examples.en: Children learn to distinguish right from wrong.
examples.zh: 孩子們學著分辨是非對錯。

examples.en: Her bright red coat distinguishes her from the crowd.
examples.zh: 她鮮紅色的外套讓她在人群中顯得與眾不同。

examples.en: The school invited a distinguished writer to give a talk.
examples.zh: 學校邀請了一位傑出的作家來演講。

examples.en: He has had a distinguished career as a doctor.
examples.zh: 他擔任醫生的職涯相當卓越。

examples.en: The professor is a distinguished member of the committee.
examples.zh: 這位教授是委員會中備受敬重的成員。

examples.en: The teacher will distribute the test papers to the students.
examples.zh: 老師會把考卷發給學生。

examples.en: Volunteers distribute free meals to people in need.
examples.zh: 志工們把免費餐點發給有需要的人。

examples.en: The company distributes its products to stores across Taiwan.
examples.zh: 這家公司把產品配送到全台各地的商店。

examples.en: The distribution of free tickets begins at nine o'clock.
examples.zh: 免費門票的分發從九點開始。

examples.en: The company has a large distribution network in Asia.
examples.zh: 這家公司在亞洲擁有龐大的配銷網。

examples.en: A fair distribution of work makes the team happier.
examples.zh: 公平分配工作會讓團隊更開心。

examples.en: Our school is in the busiest district of the city.
examples.zh: 我們學校位在市內最熱鬧的地區。

examples.en: This district has many old temples and tea shops.
examples.zh: 這一區有許多古老的廟宇和茶行。

examples.en: Daan District is a popular place for students to live.
examples.zh: 大安區是學生很愛居住的地方。

examples.en: Please don't disturb your brother while he is studying.
examples.zh: 你哥哥在讀書時，請不要打擾他。

examples.en: Loud music from next door disturbed our sleep.
examples.zh: 隔壁傳來的大聲音樂吵到了我們睡覺。

examples.en: The news about the accident disturbed everyone in the office.
examples.zh: 那起意外的消息讓辦公室裡的每個人都感到不安。

examples.en: People visit the temple to pray for divine help.
examples.zh: 人們到廟裡祈求神明的幫助。

examples.en: The old story is about a divine messenger.
examples.zh: 這個古老的故事是關於一位神聖的使者。

examples.en: The chocolate cake at that café tastes divine.
examples.zh: 那家咖啡店的巧克力蛋糕美味極了。

examples.en: Their divorce was hard on the whole family.
examples.zh: 他們離婚對全家人都是很大的打擊。

examples.en: She said that divorce was the right choice for her.
examples.zh: 她說離婚對她來說是正確的選擇。

examples.en: The number of divorces has risen in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年來離婚的件數增加了。

examples.en: He divorced his wife after ten years of marriage.
examples.zh: 結婚十年後，他和妻子離婚了。

examples.en: My aunt divorced and moved to Taichung.
examples.zh: 我阿姨離婚後搬到了臺中。

examples.en: They decided to divorce and remain good friends.
examples.zh: 他們決定離婚，並繼續當好朋友。

senses.zh: 占優勢的；主要的；顯性的

examples.en: Our team was dominant in the second half of the game.
examples.zh: 我們隊在下半場占了上風。

examples.en: English is the dominant language of international business.
examples.zh: 英文是國際商務上的主要語言。

examples.en: Brown eyes are a dominant trait in many families.
examples.zh: 棕色眼睛在許多家庭中是顯性特徵。

examples.en: Large companies dominate the smartphone market.
examples.zh: 大公司主導了智慧型手機市場。

examples.en: One loud student tried to dominate the class discussion.
examples.zh: 有一位大聲的學生想要主導課堂討論。

examples.en: The tall tower dominates the view of the city.
examples.zh: 那座高塔在這座城市的景色中格外醒目。

examples.en: I wrote the first draft of my essay on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我星期天寫了作文的初稿。

examples.en: The committee will read the draft of the new rules tomorrow.
examples.zh: 委員會明天會閱讀新規定的草案。

examples.en: A cold draft came in through the open window.
examples.zh: 一陣冷風從打開的窗戶吹進來。

examples.en: She drafted a short letter to her landlord.
examples.zh: 她草擬了一封寫給房東的簡簡短信件件。

examples.en: The manager drafted a plan for the new project.
examples.zh: 經理草擬了新專案的計畫。

examples.en: We drafted the speech together in the library.
examples.zh: 我們一起在圖書館擬定演講稿。

examples.en: Many students dread the day of the final exam.
examples.zh: 許多學生害怕期末考當天的到來。

examples.en: I dread going to the dentist.
examples.zh: 我很怕去看牙醫。

examples.en: She dreaded telling her parents about the broken window.
examples.zh: 她很擔心要告訴爸媽窗戶破了的事。

examples.en: He felt a dread of speaking in front of the class.
examples.zh: 他對在全班面前說話感到恐懼。

examples.en: Her dread of flying kept her from traveling abroad.
examples.zh: 她對搭飛機的恐懼讓她無法出國旅行。

examples.en: The long wait for the test results filled him with dread.
examples.zh: 等待檢查結果的漫長時間讓他充滿憂慮。

senses.zh: 漂流；飄移；漫無目的地走

examples.en: The small boat drifted slowly down the river.
examples.zh: 那艘小船沿著河慢慢漂流而下。

examples.en: Snow drifted past the window all afternoon.
examples.zh: 整個下午，雪花都飄過窗外。

examples.en: After graduation, he drifted from job to job.
examples.zh: 畢業後，他一份工作換過一份工作，漫無目標。

examples.en: The drift of the boat took it far from the shore.
examples.zh: 船隻的漂流讓它遠離了海岸。

examples.en: There is a drift toward online shopping among young people.
examples.zh: 年輕人之間有朝網路購物發展的趨勢。

examples.en: A drift of snow blocked the front door.
examples.zh: 一堆積雪擋住了前門。

examples.en: Dad used an electric drill to hang the shelf.
examples.zh: 爸爸用電鑽把架子裝到牆上。

examples.en: Our school holds a fire drill every semester.
examples.zh: 我們學校每學期都會舉辦一次消防演習。

examples.en: The English teacher gave us a grammar drill.
examples.zh: 英文老師給了我們一份文法練習題。

examples.en: The workers drilled a hole in the wall.
examples.zh: 工人在牆上鑽了一個洞。

examples.en: The coach drilled the players on passing.
examples.zh: 教練反覆訓練球員傳球。

examples.en: She drills new vocabulary with flash cards every night.
examples.zh: 她每晚用單字卡反覆練習新單字。

examples.en: The medicine made me feel drowsy in class.
examples.zh: 這個藥讓我在課堂上覺得昏昏欲睡。

examples.en: A warm afternoon can make anyone drowsy.
examples.zh: 溫暖的午後會讓任何人想睡覺。

examples.en: The drowsy driver stopped to rest at the next station.
examples.zh: 昏昏欲睡的司機在下一個休息站停下來休息。

examples.en: This backpack is made of durable cloth.
examples.zh: 這個背包是用耐用的布料製成的。

examples.en: The company sells durable shoes for hiking.
examples.zh: 這家公司販售耐用的登山鞋。

examples.en: A durable friendship can last for many years.
examples.zh: 一段持久的友誼可以延續很多年。

examples.en: The old books on the shelf were dusty.
examples.zh: 架上的舊書積滿了灰塵。

examples.en: We cleaned the dusty attic last weekend.
examples.zh: 我們上週末打掃了灰塵滿布的閣樓。

examples.en: The dusty road led to a small village.
examples.zh: 那條塵土飛揚的路通往一個小村莊。

examples.en: She decided to dye her hair brown.
examples.zh: 她決定把頭髮染成棕色。

examples.en: We dyed the cloth blue in art class.
examples.zh: 我們在美術課把布染成了藍色。

examples.en: My mother dyes eggs for the festival every year.
examples.zh: 我媽媽每年都為了節慶把蛋染色。

examples.en: The dye washed out after a few weeks.
examples.zh: 染劑幾個星期後就褪色了。

examples.en: This store sells natural dye made from plants.
examples.zh: 這家店販售由植物製成的天然染料。

examples.en: He bought a bottle of hair dye at the drugstore.
examples.zh: 他在藥妝店買了一瓶染髮劑。

examples.en: Our new manager is a dynamic young woman.
examples.zh: 我們的新經理是一位充滿活力的年輕女性。

examples.en: Taipei is a dynamic city with many night markets.
examples.zh: 臺北是一座充滿活力、有許多夜市的城市。

examples.en: The website shows dynamic maps that update every minute.
examples.zh: 這個網站顯示每分鐘更新的動態地圖。

examples.en: The Tang dynasty is famous for its poetry.
examples.zh: 唐朝以詩詞聞名。

examples.en: We learned about the Ming dynasty in history class.
examples.zh: 我們在歷史課學到了明朝。

examples.en: That family has run the business as a dynasty for years.
examples.zh: 那個家族多年來把這家企業當成世家經營。

examples.en: He made an earnest effort to learn Japanese.
examples.zh: 他認真努力學習日語。

examples.en: The student gave an earnest apology to the teacher.
examples.zh: 那位學生誠摯地向老師道歉。

examples.en: She is an earnest girl who always does her homework.
examples.zh: 她是個認真的女孩，總是按時寫作業。

examples.en: The government announced a new economic plan.
examples.zh: 政府宣布了一項新的經濟計畫。

examples.en: Economic growth has slowed down this year.
examples.zh: 今年的經濟成長趨緩。

examples.en: Many students study economic history in college.
examples.zh: 許多學生在大學修習經濟史。

examples.en: This small car is very economical to drive.
examples.zh: 這台小車開起來非常省錢。

examples.en: We took an economical trip by staying with friends.
examples.zh: 我們住在朋友家，過了一趟經濟實惠的旅行。

examples.en: Buying in large amounts is often more economical.
examples.zh: 大量購買通常比較划算。

examples.en: My sister studies economics at National Taiwan University.
examples.zh: 我姊姊在臺灣大學讀經濟學。

examples.en: Economics explains how people choose what to buy.
examples.zh: 經濟學解釋了人們如何選擇要買什麼。

examples.en: The economics of running a small shop are not easy.
examples.zh: 經營小店的經濟層面並不容易。

examples.en: The economist spoke about rising prices on the news.
examples.zh: 那位經濟學家在新聞上談到物價上漲。

examples.en: An economist from the bank gave a talk at our school.
examples.zh: 銀行的一位經濟學家到我們學校演講。

examples.en: She hopes to become an economist one day.
examples.zh: 她希望有一天能成為經濟學家。

examples.en: The economy grew faster than experts expected.
examples.zh: 經濟成長得比專家預期的還快。

examples.en: Tourism is important to the local economy.
examples.zh: 觀光對當地經濟很重要。

examples.en: For economy, we always buy food in large packs.
examples.zh: 為了節省開銷，我們總是買大包裝的食物。

examples.en: We booked economy seats on the flight to Tokyo.
examples.zh: 我們訂了飛往東京的經濟艙座位。

examples.en: She bought an economy pack of paper towels.
examples.zh: 她買了一大包經濟包裝的紙巾。

examples.en: The airline offers economy fares on weekdays.
examples.zh: 這家航空公司平日提供經濟艙票價。

examples.en: The new software improved the efficiency of our office.
examples.zh: 新軟體提升了我們辦公室的效率。

examples.en: The efficiency of this machine saves a lot of electricity.
examples.zh: 這台機器的效能很高，能節省很多電。

examples.en: Good planning leads to greater efficiency at work.
examples.zh: 好的規劃能帶來更高的工作效率。

examples.en: The skirt has an elastic waistband.
examples.zh: 這條裙子有鬆緊腰帶。

examples.en: Rubber is an elastic material that can stretch.
examples.zh: 橡膠是一種可以拉長的有彈性的材料。

examples.en: An elastic schedule lets workers plan their own days.
examples.zh: 有彈性的時程表讓員工能自行安排日子。

examples.en: She tied her hair back with a piece of elastic.
examples.zh: 她用一條橡皮筋把頭髮綁起來。

examples.en: The elastic in my old socks has worn out.
examples.zh: 我舊襪子的鬆緊帶已經鬆掉了。

examples.en: Mom sewed new elastic into the pants.
examples.zh: 媽媽把新的鬆緊帶縫進了褲子裡。

examples.en: The store sells phones, cameras, and other electronics.
examples.zh: 這家店販售手機、相機和其他電子產品。

examples.en: My brother wants to study electronics at university.
examples.zh: 我弟弟想在大學學電子學。

examples.en: Please keep electronics away from water.
examples.zh: 請讓電子產品遠離水。

senses.zh: 優雅的；高雅的；簡潔漂亮的

examples.en: She wore an elegant black dress to the concert.
examples.zh: 她穿著一件優雅的黑色洋裝去聽音樂會。

examples.en: The hotel has an elegant dining room.
examples.zh: 這家飯店有一間高雅的餐廳。

examples.en: The teacher showed us an elegant solution to the math problem.
examples.zh: 老師向我們展示了這道數學題簡潔漂亮的解法。

examples.en: My little brother goes to elementary school.
examples.zh: 我弟弟讀國小。

examples.en: We started with elementary math lessons.
examples.zh: 我們從基礎的數學課開始。

examples.en: The class teaches elementary skills for using a computer.
examples.zh: 這堂課教授使用電腦的基本技能。

examples.en: The new program aims to eliminate waste in the cafeteria.
examples.zh: 這項新計畫的目標是消除餐廳的浪費。

examples.en: Our team was eliminated in the second round.
examples.zh: 我們隊在第二輪被淘汰了。

examples.en: The doctor asked him to eliminate sugar from his diet.
examples.zh: 醫生要他在飲食中排除糖分。
